mathematical_results.claim: Independent field-sign invariance forces mixed sign projection to zero even for noncommuting bright-sector generators.
mathematical_results.key_premises: Shared nuisance; temporally disjoint fields; generator separately even under each sign; identical preparation/readout.

mathematical_results.claim: Finite-overlap local quadratic contamination is bounded by the integrated norm of the cross-field generator.
mathematical_results.missing_interface: Independent finite material-generator and pulse-overlap bound.

mathematical_results.claim: Parallel time scans plus crossed bright scans do not determine the crossed dark response in the causal isotropic rank-four tensor class.
mathematical_results.qualification: No arbitrary response completion is asserted to be a distinct microscopic Hamiltonian.

strongest_same_input_incumbent: Polarization-selective attosecond FWM with vectorial heterodyne readout and globally refitted causal response or microscopic models.
